summary.text: Rob Bloxom is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 100th District since February 26, 2014.
The district covers the Counties of Accomack and Northampton and part of the City of Virginia Beach.
The House profile lists Rob Bloxom's occupation as sales/aquaculturalist.

paragraphs.text: Rob Bloxom was born in Salisbury, Maryland.
The profile lists Broadwater Academy (1981) and a University of Richmond B.A. in Economics/Sociology.
The profile lists membership on the church council of Grace United Methodist Church, service as a director of an Economic Development Authority, and membership in the Onancock Rotary.
Rob Bloxom serves on the Privileges and Elections, Appropriations, General Laws, and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources committees.
